title: Adaptive reuse element objectives
text: O4.13.1 New additions to existing buildings are contemporary and complementary and do not detract from the character and scale of the existing building. O4.13.2 Residential dwellings within an adapted building provide good amenity for residents, generally in accordance with the requirements of this Code.
notes: Register C4P2-129: Vol2 Appendix A6 (summary list of all element objectives) is deleted with no draft equivalent, so these O records are the only listing of the 4.x objectives. Register C4P2-123: the local planning framework route to modify this element is tightened (Chapter 1 Table 3.5A).
